alerts.title: Weight Gain on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines state DTG can cause weight gain. Patient has gained 9 kg in the past year, with a current BMI of 33. DTG is a known cause, but other factors like diet and exercise should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Consider switching from DTG due to weight gain
